क़ोटेशन लें

हम क्या करते हैं

एफबीए सोर्सिंग
& निरीक्षण

एक पैकेज - आपूर्तिकर्ता खोज से लेकर Amazon-तैयार कार्टन तक। जब आवश्यक हो, प्राइवेट लेबल, फोटोग्राफी, 1688 खरीदारी, या वेयरहाउसिंग जोड़ें।

कोर पैकेज

एफबीए सोर्सिंग
और निरीक्षण

हम हर एफबीए विक्रेता को सुझाने वाला एकल पैकेज। "मैं यह बेचना चाहता हूँ" से लेबल किया हुआ, निरीक्षित, अमेज़न-तैयार कार्टन तक का पूरा प्रक्रिया - एक एजेंट द्वारा संभाला जाता है।

कीमत कैसे तय होती है

एजेंट शुल्क 5–8% · निरीक्षण $150/दिन · एफबीए प्रीपाई प्रति यूनिट - सभी एक कोटेशन पर दर्ज होते हैं।

मुफ़्त कोटेशन प्राप्त करें
  1. 01

    Supplier sourcing

    3–5 verified suppliers with real pricing — licences, factory address, and export history checked before we quote.

  2. 02

    Sample confirmation

    We order and evaluate the sample against your spec and your customer's expectations before you commit to bulk.

  3. 03

    Full-batch inspection

    Pre-shipment QC at the factory: appearance, dimensions, function, packaging, and FBA label check.

  4. 04

    FBA Prep

    FNSKU labelling, poly-bagging, bundling, weighing and measuring to Amazon's exact specification.

  5. 05

    Freight coordination

    Air, sea, or express compared; customs paperwork handled; door-to-door DDP with live tracking.

कार्य उदाहरण — $1,000 का ऑर्डर

आपूर्तिकर्ता कीमत (माल)$1,000
एजेंट शुल्क (8%)$80
Freightवास्तविक कोटेशन पर
आपकी कुल लागतकोई छिपे शुल्क नहीं

आपूर्तिकर्ता कीमत + एजेंट शुल्क + मालभाड़ा = आपका कुल भुगतान। और कुछ नहीं।

अतिरिक्त सेवाएँ

वैकल्पिक एड-ऑन
जब आपको ज़रूरत हो

प्रत्येक एड-ऑन एक विशिष्ट समस्या का समाधान करता है। उन्हें अलग-अलग लें, या अपने कोर पैकेज में बंडल करें।

Private Label & Packaging Design

यह किस समस्या का समाधान करता है
Your product needs to look like a brand, not a generic import — and weak packaging kills conversion.
हम क्या करते हैं
Logo placement, box / bag / label artwork, insert cards, and MOQ negotiation with the packaging factory.
इसकी कीमत कैसे तय होती है
A flat design fee plus packaging at factory cost. MOQ typically 300–1,000 pcs.
इसके बारे में पूछें

Product Photography

यह किस समस्या का समाधान करता है
Amazon buries — or blocks — listings whose main image doesn't meet the white-background standard.
हम क्या करते हैं
White-background shots to Amazon main-image spec, plus lifestyle and infographic variants on request.
इसकी कीमत कैसे तय होती है
Per-image rate, cheaper at volume. Flat rate per SKU available.
इसके बारे में पूछें

1688 Purchasing Service

यह किस समस्या का समाधान करता है
The lowest prices live on 1688 — but the site is Chinese-only and won't ship overseas.
हम क्या करते हैं
Send a product link or photo. We buy from the 1688 seller, inspect, consolidate, and ship to you.
इसकी कीमत कैसे तय होती है
A percentage of order value with a small minimum. No Chinese required.
इसके बारे में पूछें

Warehousing & Transshipment

यह किस समस्या का समाधान करता है
Buying from several suppliers means several international freight bills — and no one checking the goods.
हम क्या करते हैं
We receive, inspect, repack, and consolidate multiple orders into a single shipment from our warehouse.
इसकी कीमत कैसे तय होती है
Storage per cubic metre per day, plus a consolidation fee per order.
इसके बारे में पूछें

हमारी प्रक्रिया

एक सामान्य ऑर्डर कैसा होता है
Flows

  1. Day 1 01

    You submit your product

    Product details, quantity, quality bar, and budget via our inquiry form.

  2. Day 2 02

    We send supplier options

    3–5 verified suppliers with quotes and profiles, ready for your review.

  3. Day 3–5 03

    Sample & negotiation

01

Verified suppliers only

We vet every supplier before you pay a cent.

यह कैसे काम करता है

  1. 01
    Shortlist Day 1–2

    We pull 3–5 candidates from our own factory network and from 1688, matched to your product spec.

  2. 02
    Paper check Day 2–3

    Business licence, registered address, production capacity, and export history — checked against the factory itself, not a sales page.

  3. 03
    Live walkthrough Day 3–5

    A video call through the workshop: the real line, the real stock, the real sample.

What we verify

  • Licence & legal entity Business licence matched to the name that will appear on your invoice.
  • Address vs. workshop The registered address is cross-checked against where the goods are actually made.
  • Capacity & lead time Whether they can hold your quantity, your deadline, and your reorder.
  • Export history Past shipments and existing clients — who they already sell to abroad.
  • Live production line Seen on video before a single dollar leaves your account.

अगर यह विफल होता हैIf a factory cannot clear the paper check or refuses a live walkthrough, it never reaches your quote. We keep looking.

02

QC before shipping

Photo report + pass/fail before your money moves.

यह कैसे काम करता है

  1. 01
    Book the inspection Day before the batch closes

    Scheduled against the production end date — not the ship date, so there is still time to fix things.

  2. 02
    On-site full-batch check Half a day, typical

    We stand at the factory, count, measure, test, and photograph the batch ourselves.

  3. 03
    Report & verdict Same day

    You receive the photo report with a clear pass/fail, the defect count, and the sampling standard used.

  4. 04
    Rework or replace 3–7 days

    A fail goes straight back to the supplier for rework or replacement — then we re-inspect before packing.

What we check

  • Appearance Surfaces, colour, finish, stitching, print, and visible damage — against the approved sample.
  • Dimensions Weight and measurements to spec, with out-of-tolerance units flagged individually.
  • Function Every sampled unit powered on, assembled, or used exactly as your customer will use it.
  • Packaging Retail box, poly-bag, suffocation warning, inserts, and carton strength.
  • FBA labels FNSKU barcodes scan, carton labels correct, weights and dimensions to Amazon spec.

अगर यह विफल होता हैIf the batch fails, it does not ship. The supplier reworks or replaces it, and your balance stays with us until it passes.

03

Payment protection

We hold funds until milestones clear. No wires to strangers.

यह कैसे काम करता है

  1. 01
    PO written with milestones Day 1

    Deposit, production, inspection, and shipment are fixed as separate release points before anything starts.

  2. 02
    Deposit released Day 1–2

    Only the agreed deposit goes out, and only after you approve the PO in writing.

  3. 03
    Inspection gate At QC

    The production balance is not released until the inspection report comes back as a pass.

  4. 04
    Final settlement On your sign-off

    The balance settles after you approve, with a written receipt on your invoice.

How your money is held

  • You approve every release No payment moves without your written go-ahead at that milestone.
  • Supplier paid by us We pay the factory directly — you never send money to an unknown account.
  • No personal accounts Funds never go to a personal bank account or a third-party wallet.
  • No full prepayment Nobody receives 100% up front — not the supplier, not us.
  • Receipt on every transfer Each release is documented and itemised against your order.

अगर यह विफल होता हैIf a milestone does not clear, we stop the order and the money stays with you — nobody is paid for work that did not happen.

04

DDP door delivery

Tracking and goods — not paperwork.

यह कैसे काम करता है

  1. 01
    Book & consolidate Day 1–2

    We choose the carrier, book the space, and consolidate your cartons into a single shipment.

  2. 02
    Export & documents 2–3 days

    Export declaration, packing list, and commercial invoice — prepared and filed on our side.

  3. 03
    Freight & import Air 5–8 days · Sea 25–35 days

    Air or sea freight, with duty and customs cleared under DDP so nothing lands on you.

  4. 04
    Door delivery 1–3 days

    Last mile to your address or straight to Amazon, tracked end to end.

What is included

  • Door-to-door DDP One price from the factory gate to your door — no surprise customs invoice.
  • Duty & taxes Included in the quote, itemised separately so you can see it.
  • Live tracking A tracking number that works from departure to delivery.
  • Packing list & invoice The paperwork Amazon and your forwarder will ask for.
  • FBA or your address Delivered to an Amazon warehouse or to you — your choice at booking.

अगर यह विफल होता हैIf a shipment is delayed, held, or lost, we chase the carrier and file the claim. The paperwork is ours to fight, not yours.

FAQ

Common
Questions

What does the FBA Sourcing & Inspection package include?

Supplier sourcing, sample confirmation, full-batch inspection, FBA prep (labelling, bagging, weighing, measuring), and freight coordination — one accountable agent, one quote.

How much is your service fee?

Agent fee is 5–8% of order value. Inspection is $150/day (most orders finish in half a day). FBA prep is charged per unit. Everything is itemised on your quote before you commit.

What is your minimum order size?

No strict minimum, but we work best with orders of $300 USD or more. Smaller orders may have fewer supplier options.

What if goods fail inspection?

We work with the supplier to resolve — rework, replacement, or refund — before anything ships. We never release final payment without your approval.

Do you handle FBA prep and labelling?

Yes. FNSKU labels, poly-bagging, bundling, carton labels, weights and dimensions to Amazon's spec — so your shipment clears receiving the first time.

Can I get custom packaging with my logo?

Yes — that's our Private Label & Packaging add-on. Boxes, bags, labels, and hang tags. MOQ varies by supplier, typically 300–1,000 pieces.
